title: copaiba kuntzei
intro: Copaiba kuntzei, commonly known as Copaiba Kunzeana, is a species of evergreen tree native to South America, belonging to the Burseraceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Copaiba kuntzei's therapeutic actions include pain relief, wound healing, and immune system modulation, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as beta-caryophyllene and alpha-pinene. The essential oil extracted from the plant's resin has been found to contain sesquiterpenes, including guaiol, and diterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
